entries.text: BLAZAR is the manager-only orchestrator: it plans once, decomposes into a DAG, dispatches every node to a named Arsenal specialist, verifies, integrates, and maintains AGENT.md and WORKFLOW.md. It never executes node work itself.
BLAZAR carries mode primary and color #4169E1, a six-digit hex value in the V2-conformant shape for the agent UI color field.
BLAZAR denies subagent dispatch by default and allows exactly architect, code-reviewer, ai-generated-code-security-auditor, technical-writer, red-team, kit-maintainer, and explore.
BLAZAR denies skill use by default and allows vantrilex-workflow-forge, babel-bridge, circuit-breaker-guard, documentation-as-tests, and github-release-packager among its allowed skills.
BLAZAR carries no model pin per the DEFAULT-ONLY law; it inherits the user's configured default model.
